title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: device health reporting dashboard (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: its government-cloud availability, portal paths, access roles and Endpoint DLP licensing agree with the sources. It correctly distinguishes readiness warnings from confirmed policy synchronisation and keeps dashboard enablement and automation gaps explicit.

claims.claim: The feature is a Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention device health reporting dashboard.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Device Health Reporting Dashboard

claims.claim: The roadmap describes viewing device health across all devices and quickly identifying devices that are not ready.
claims.quote: This dashboard will allow admins to view the device health across all their devices to ensure the system is healthy and ready to receive policy updates and quickly identify devices that are not ready.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The dashboard centralises device onboarding, policy update readiness and feature readiness for compliance and security administrators.
claims.quote: The device health reporting dashboard in Microsoft Purview gives compliance and security administrators a centralized view of device readiness for Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (Endpoint DLP).

claims.claim: The dashboard helps find devices that might not receive or enforce Endpoint DLP policies because of configuration, connectivity or version issues.
claims.quote: The dashboard helps you find devices that might not be ready to receive or enforce Endpoint DLP policies because of configuration, connectivity, or version issues.

claims.claim: The Learn page describes four dashboard sections.
claims.quote: Device onboarding; Device readiness to receive policy updates; Last time devices were seen online; Device readiness for feature

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Device onboarding displays the total number of onboarded devices.
claims.quote: Provides an overview of onboarded devices, including: total onboarded devices

claims.claim: Device onboarding displays onboarded devices running Endpoint DLP.
claims.quote: onboarded devices running Endpoint DLP

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Device onboarding displays onboarded devices with configuration issues.
claims.quote: onboarded devices with configuration issues

claims.claim: Device readiness to receive policy updates identifies devices at risk because they were offline during the past day.
claims.quote: Shows devices that may not be ready to receive future Endpoint DLP policy updates because of: offline status during the past day

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Device readiness to receive policy updates identifies devices with outdated Microsoft Defender Antivirus versions.
claims.quote: Shows devices that may not be ready to receive future Endpoint DLP policy updates because of: offline status during the past day, outdated Microsoft Defender Antivirus versions, configuration issues.

claims.claim: Device readiness to receive policy updates identifies devices at risk because of configuration issues.
claims.quote: Shows devices that may not be ready to receive future Endpoint DLP policy updates because of: offline status during the past day, outdated Microsoft Defender Antivirus versions, configuration issues.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Last time devices were seen online groups devices by their latest Last seen timestamp into 24-hour, 3-day, 7-day and 30-day buckets.
claims.quote: Devices are grouped into separate, non-cumulative buckets based on their latest Last seen timestamp, including devices seen in the last 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days, and 30 days.

claims.claim: The Last seen buckets are non-cumulative.
claims.quote: Each device is counted only once in the most recent applicable bucket.

claims.quote: Currently, this section supports readiness reporting for: Just-in-time protection, Paste to supported browsers.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope; Risk assessment; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The dashboard displays devices that reported within the past 30 days.

claims.claim: Learn says the dashboard reduces manual troubleshooting across multiple pages.
claims.quote: It consolidates device health insights, reducing manual troubleshooting across multiple pages.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Readiness indicators highlight risks to future updates rather than confirming that a device failed to receive an update.
claims.quote: These indicators don't confirm whether a device failed to receive a policy update, but instead highlight devices that may be at risk of not receiving future updates.

claims.claim: An unflagged readiness indicator is not confirmation that a device holds the latest policy.
claims.quote: These indicators don't confirm whether a device failed to receive a policy update, but instead highlight devices that may be at risk of not receiving future updates.

claims.claim: Learn advises using the least-privileged role that meets the need and says Compliance Administrator or Security Administrator is sufficient for most organisations.
claims.quote: Use the least-privileged role that meets your needs. For most organizations, the Compliance Administrator or Security Administrator role is sufficient.

claims.claim: The per-device attributes include a Valid user value.
claims.quote: Valid user | This indicates if the currently logged on user has a corresponding Entra ID account and is in scope of a DLP policy that's targeted at Devices.

claims.claim: DlpInfo can carry a DlpUpn property identifying the user associated with the device.
claims.quote: DlpUpn | string | User principal name (UPN) associated with the device.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Outdated Microsoft Defender Antivirus versions can prevent devices from receiving Endpoint DLP policies.
claims.quote: Prioritize remediation for devices with outdated Defender versions. Outdated Microsoft Defender Antivirus versions can prevent devices from receiving Endpoint DLP policies.

claims.claim: Devices offline for extended periods may miss critical policy updates.
claims.quote: Devices offline for extended periods may miss critical policy updates.

claims.claim: Learn describes the dashboard as a monitoring and investigation view, not an autonomous remediation mechanism.
claims.quote: Use the dashboard to monitor device posture at scale, find misconfigured devices, detect devices that might not receive Endpoint DLP policy updates, and validate readiness before deploying new features.

claims.claim: A device that has not reported for more than 30 days falls outside the dashboard's data window.
claims.quote: The dashboard displays data from devices that reported within the past 30 days.

claims.claim: Per-device Policy sync status provides confirmation of whether the latest policy reached the device.
claims.quote: The Policy sync status shows you if the device received the latest policy version, or if the corresponding policies synced successfully to the device.

claims.claim: Learn's best practices advise reviewing the dashboard regularly.
claims.quote: Review the dashboard regularly. Frequent checks help you catch device health trends before they become widespread issues.

claims.claim: Learn advises investigating devices that have not reported recently.
claims.quote: Investigate devices that haven't reported recently. Devices offline for extended periods may miss critical policy updates.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Why it matters
claims.claim: The dashboard helps administrators investigate devices and identify root causes including outdated versions, connectivity issues and invalid configurations.
claims.quote: Investigate individual devices. Identify root cause issues such as: Outdated versions; Connectivity issues; Invalid configurations

claims.where: Governance controls; controls[1].note; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: DeviceInfo enables scripted analysis of the same Endpoint DLP device attributes available in the Purview device onboarding page.
claims.quote: In addition to viewing device attributes in the Microsoft Purview portal, you can access the same Endpoint DLP device data through the DeviceInfo table in Advanced hunting.

claims.claim: The DlpInfo column contains JSON properties for reporting configuration status, policy synchronisation and Endpoint DLP enablement.
claims.quote: The DlpInfo column contains Endpoint Data Loss Prevention device information in JSON format. The JSON object can be used to query and report on device configuration status, policy synchronization status, Endpoint DLP enablement, and other configuration details for onboarded devices.
